subject.title: feat(webui): reintroduce opt-in AI purpose titles for tool calls

question: Should OpenClaw accept this new core config and RPC surface for optional decorative tool titles once its privacy wording and proof are corrected?
rationale: The preceding merged change deliberately restored deterministic-only rendering, while this PR adds model egress, token spend, caching, configuration, and protocol surface that repository policy treats as an explicit product choice.

options.title: Accept the opt-in feature
options.body: Keep the default-off implementation after correcting its provider disclosure and supplying real behavior proof.

options.title: Remain deterministic-only
options.body: Decline the new config and RPC surface and retain the current model-free tool rendering.

recommendation.title: Accept the opt-in feature
recommendation.body: Keep the default-off implementation after correcting its provider disclosure and supplying real behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced and merged both the title feature and its deterministic removal and has the strongest current-main history across the affected surfaces.
